texts.preamble: M/S.Hindustan Unilever Limited vs The Food Safety Officer on 7 December, 2023 Author: G.Jayachandran Bench: G.Jayachandran Crl.O.P.No.229 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 07.12.2023 Coram : The Honourable Dr. Justice G.Jayachandran Crl.O.P.No.22969 of 2023 and Crl.M.P. Nos.16110 & 16111 of 2023 M/ s. Hindustan Unilever Limited, Rep. by its Authorised Signatory, Mr.Bharadwaj Sekar, A-5, Phase -Ii, Focal Point, Rajpura District, Patiala, Punjab - 140 401. ... -vs- The Food Safety Officer, Area Code No.348, Sholinghur Block, Office of the Appointing Officer, Tamil Nadu Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration, 2nd Floor, B-Block, District Collector Office Complex, Vellore - 632 009. ...Res Prayer : Criminal Original Petition has been filed under Section 407 of Criminal Procedure Code, to call for the records relating to the S.T.C. of 2023 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Sholingur and qu same by allowing this criminal Original Petition. Page No.1/6 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.No. M/S.Hindustan Unilever Limited vs The Food Safety Officer on 7 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40076450/ 1 For Petitioner : Mr.Jose John & Mr.G.Joshua Akkil Ebinezar For Respondent :Mr.Leonard Arul Joseph Selvam, Government Advocate (Crl.Side) Order
texts.facts: This petition is filed to quash the complaint filed otherwise than the police report and taken cognizance by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Sholingur in S.T.C. No.132 of 2023. 2.The respondent is the Food Safety Officer. The petitioner is the Authorised Signatory of M/s.Hindustan Unilever Limited which manufactures the Kissan Chotu Fresh Tomato Ketchup. As per the complaint, inspection was conducted on the premises of the first accused, who is the proprietor of Bala Ganapathy Agencies, the provision store at Sholingur. The sample of Kissan Chotu Fresh Tomato Ketchup stored for sale was drawn and sent for analysis. The FSL report indicated that the food product is Unsafe and therefore after causing show cause notice calling for explanation, prosecution has been launched after obtaining sanction from the Commissioner. 3. The said complaint is challenged on two grounds primarily, on the ground that the complaint is barred by limitation, hence the cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate after three years of the occurrence is barred by Section https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 46(3) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. Secondly, the substances found in the sample is not a prohibited substance and it is incorrect to say that the food product is Unsafe.
texts.arguments: 4. The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) fairly concedes that the prosecution was launched, since the analysis report conducted on the food product reported that Benzoic Acid been used as a preservative by the manufacturer and the quantitative analysis showed the presence of Benzoic Acid to be 602.30 mg/Kg and as per Regulation No.2.3.27 r/w 12.6.2 of Food Category System in Appendix -A of FSSR (FPS & FA), 2011, it should be negative, but the said analysis report is not in consonance with the entries found in the said Schedule which actually permits the presence of Benzoic Acid as a preservative or Additive upto 1000 mg/Kg.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) fairly concedes that the prosecution was launched, since the analysis report conducted on the food product reported that Benzoic Acid been used as a preservative by the manufacturer and the quantitative analysis showed the presence of Benzoic Acid to be 602.30 mg/Kg and as per Regulation No.2.3.27 r/w 12.6.2 of Food Category System in Appendix -A of FSSR (FPS & FA), 2011, it should be negative, but the said analysis report is not in consonance with the entries found in the said Schedule which actually permits the presence of Benzoic Acid as a preservative or Additive upto 1000 mg/Kg.
